_about: What answers at each number the modem dials (PR#2, ATDT) and RUN DEMONDIAL
sweeps. Numbers are 555-01xx, the block set aside for fiction. Any number
not listed rings out, is busy, or a person answers, the same every time.
answers: computer (a carrier: CONNECT at baud), fax, busy, voice (says:
spoken). A computer's system is in SYSTEMS in js/apple-IIe-programs.js.
Nobody is told these numbers; they turn up on the disk, the BBS, gopher.
